source_text: Ah. It’s much warmer in here.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Ah. It’s much warmer in here.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Ah. It’s much warmer in here."

translation: Ach. Tutaj jest znacznie cieplej.

source_text: I never suspected I would see your former wife. This is very shocking.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I never suspected I would see your former wife. This is very shocking.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I never suspected I would see your former wife. This is very shocking."

translation: Nie przypuszczałam, że zobaczę twoją byłą żonę. To naprawdę zaskakujące.

source_text: I guess our paths truly did diverge.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.I guess our paths truly did diverge.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.I guess our paths truly did diverge."

translation: Chyba nasze drogi naprawdę się rozeszły.

source_text: I don’t get it. Why did you come back to him?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp>.I don’t get it. Why did you come back to him?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp>.I don’t get it. Why did you come back to him?"

translation: Nie rozumiem. Dlaczego do niego wróciłaś?

source_text: I’m not here for Brian. I have my own reasons for coming to North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.I’m not here for Brian. I have my own reasons for coming to North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.I’m not here for Brian. I have my own reasons for coming to North Santiva."

translation: Nie przyjechałam tu dla Briana. Mam własne powody, by wrócić do North Santiva.

source_text: Reasons that involve running around the forest in the dark?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe^.Reasons that involve running around the forest in the dark?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe^.Reasons that involve running around the forest in the dark?"

translation: Powody, dla których biegasz nocą po lesie?

source_text: If you must know, yes! And it’s none of your business.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.If you must know, yes! And it’s none of your business.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.If you must know, yes! And it’s none of your business."

translation: Jeśli musisz wiedzieć, to tak! I nic ci do tego.

source_text: Wait… So is Brian the father of Tasha?

structure.raw_value: McShCl.Wait… So is Brian the father of Tasha?
structure.script_literal: "McShCl.Wait… So is Brian the father of Tasha?"

translation: Zaraz… Czy Brian jest ojcem Tashy?

source_text: Hey now… Let’s not jump to any conclusions.

structure.raw_value: NeWoCl.Hey now… Let’s not jump to any conclusions.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoCl.Hey now… Let’s not jump to any conclusions."

translation: Hej, spokojnie… Nie wyciągajmy pochopnych wniosków.

source_text: You have a daughter?

structure.raw_value: BrShClNo1^.You have a daughter?
structure.script_literal: "BrShClNo1^.You have a daughter?"

translation: Masz córkę?

source_text: The girl from the porn shop?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp>.The girl from the porn shop?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp>.The girl from the porn shop?"

translation: Tej dziewczyny ze sklepu porno?

source_text: Everybody needs to start minding their own business.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Everybody needs to start minding their own business.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Everybody needs to start minding their own business."

translation: Niech każdy zajmie się swoimi sprawami.

source_text: Are you being full of shit, Nellie?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe^.Are you being full of shit, Nellie?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe^.Are you being full of shit, Nellie?"

translation: Kłamiesz, Nellie?

source_text: Yes, you do.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe^.Yes, you do.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe^.Yes, you do."

translation: Dobrze wiesz.

source_text: Perhaps you would feel better after taking a warm shower.

structure.raw_value: JuHaEx.Perhaps you would feel better after taking a warm shower.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaEx.Perhaps you would feel better after taking a warm shower."

translation: Może poczułabyś się lepiej po ciepłym prysznicu.

source_text: I really need to get going.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.I really need to get going.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.I really need to get going."

translation: Naprawdę muszę już iść.

source_text: But you’ve gotten all wet and dirty. Surely you’d feel better if you cleaned up.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.But you’ve gotten all wet and dirty. Surely you’d feel better if you cleaned up.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.But you’ve gotten all wet and dirty. Surely you’d feel better if you cleaned up."

translation: Ale cała zmokłaś i się ubrudziłaś. Na pewno poczujesz się lepiej, jeśli się umyjesz.

source_text: This is crazy. Father Solomon might be a father… I mean… A real father.

structure.raw_value: ChShCl>.This is crazy. Father Solomon might be a father… I mean… A real father.
structure.script_literal: "ChShCl>.This is crazy. Father Solomon might be a father… I mean… A real father."

translation: To szaleństwo. Ojciec Solomon może być ojcem… To znaczy… Prawdziwym ojcem.

source_text: Show me to the shower.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Show me to the shower.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Show me to the shower."

translation: Zaprowadź mnie pod prysznic.

source_text: This isn’t over, Nellie.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp>.This isn’t over, Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp>.This isn’t over, Nellie."

translation: To jeszcze nie koniec, Nellie.

source_text: I can’t believe you’re connected to Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McShOp.I can’t believe you’re connected to Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.I can’t believe you’re connected to Nellie."

translation: Nie mogę uwierzyć, że znasz Nellie.

source_text: That’s the woman, 1Hero. That’s the old ball and chain.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.That’s the woman, 1Hero. That’s the old ball and chain.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.That’s the woman, 1Hero. That’s the old ball and chain."

translation: To ta kobieta, 1Hero. Moja była żona.

source_text: Although, we didn’t have a typical relationship.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Although, we didn’t have a typical relationship.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Although, we didn’t have a typical relationship."

translation: Chociaż nasz związek nie był typowy.

source_text: That doesn’t look like the type of woman I’d have imagine you being with.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.That doesn’t look like the type of woman I’d have imagine you being with.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.That doesn’t look like the type of woman I’d have imagine you being with."

translation: Nie wygląda na kobietę, z którą wyobrażałabym sobie ciebie.

source_text: You didn’t know me twenty years ago.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.You didn’t know me twenty years ago.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.You didn’t know me twenty years ago."

translation: Nie znałeś mnie dwadzieścia lat temu.

source_text: Well, at least we found out it wasn’t Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Well, at least we found out it wasn’t Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Well, at least we found out it wasn’t Madalyn."

translation: Cóż, przynajmniej wiemy już, że to nie była Madalyn.

source_text: I’d almost rather have seen a demon.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.I’d almost rather have seen a demon.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.I’d almost rather have seen a demon."

translation: Chyba wolałbym już zobaczyć demona.

source_text: Come on, Father. She can’t be that bad.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Come on, Father. She can’t be that bad.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Come on, Father. She can’t be that bad."

translation: No już, ojcze. Nie może być aż taka zła.

source_text: Look at what she did to me.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Look at what she did to me.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Look at what she did to me."

translation: Popatrz, co mi zrobiła.

source_text: Haha. Maybe you owe her some thanks.

structure.raw_value: McHaOpNo3.Haha. Maybe you owe her some thanks.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOpNo3.Haha. Maybe you owe her some thanks."

translation: Haha. Może powinieneś jej podziękować.

source_text: Thanks for trying to help, you two.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Thanks for trying to help, you two.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Thanks for trying to help, you two."

translation: Dzięki, że próbowaliście pomóc.

source_text: Anything to protect Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Anything to protect Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Anything to protect Sister Judy."

translation: Zrobię wszystko, żeby chronić siostrę Judy.

source_text: 1Hero, give me your clothes and you can stay in my room while they dry.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.1Hero, give me your clothes and you can stay in my room while they dry.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.1Hero, give me your clothes and you can stay in my room while they dry."

translation: 1Hero, daj mi swoje ubrania. Możesz zostać w moim pokoju, póki nie wyschną.

source_text: Come on, Chloe. I’ll walk you home while 1Hero cleans up.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Come on, Chloe. I’ll walk you home while 1Hero cleans up.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Come on, Chloe. I’ll walk you home while 1Hero cleans up."

translation: Chodź, Chloe. Odprowadzę cię do domu, a 1Hero się ogarnie.

source_text: 1Hero, don’t let her leave until I get back. I’m not done with her.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.1Hero, don’t let her leave until I get back. I’m not done with her.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.1Hero, don’t let her leave until I get back. I’m not done with her."

translation: 1Hero, nie pozwól jej odejść, póki nie wrócę. Jeszcze z nią nie skończyłem.
